description: Seeded review scenarios. These cases define expectations, not published model scores.

cases.change: An authentication endpoint removes token validation before creating a session.
A persisted model gains a required field without a corresponding migration.
A public function removes a previously required response field.
A new early return leaves an opened resource unclosed.
Behavior changes without modifying or adding its directly related tests.
expected: test coverage finding or test suggestion

cases.change: A recognizable credential is introduced in a staged configuration file.
A fake provider cites a file or changed line that does not exist.
A behavior-preserving rename updates implementation and tests consistently.
